page: Microsoft Azure E32as_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Easv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this server features 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not include bundled local storage or GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach external high-performance storage volumes.

In benchmark evaluations, the E32as_v7 demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip and bzip3 compression tasks. Multi-core performance is also strong, with Geekbench multi-core and software compilation benchmarks placing in the top 25%. Memory performance is robust, with Passmark memory scores in the top 25%, though uncached large-block read and write memory bandwidth remains in the average tier. For AI workloads, the server delivers top-tier text generation speeds for small language models, but performance drops significantly for larger models.

The E32as_v7 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. By omitting bundled local disks and GPUs, the configuration reduces resource overhead for architectures relying on external network-attached Premium Storage. This virtual machine is highly suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, database caching, software compilation, text processing, and small-scale language model inference.
